The brass corners and pale tissue lining of the open trunk echo the warm light. She glances toward the camera with quiet confidence and a softly relaxed mouth. A full-length, nearly frontal frame includes her head, hands, waist, ankles, and shoes; the clothing junctions and generous trouser volume remain clearly readable against the subdued hall.
